model_gaps: Only the act of marriage (rv:MarriageConclusion) is recorded; no separate rv:Marriage state was added, since the guidelines do not say whether a reported marriage act should also yield a state factoid.

No role for the person who formulates a judgment without pronouncing it; Vitztum Ulrich is recorded as rv:Participant. The princes who pronounce the Fürstenspruch are named only inside that compound and get no reference.
No way to express that a right is excluded; the exclusion of 'weibliche Erbfolge' is kept only as rf:qualifier "ausgeschlossen" on the judgment.

The regest links the dispute to the confirmation only through 'auf Grund der Klage'; rf:refersToAct is reserved for later acts referring to earlier ones, so the link is kept only as rf:ground on the confirmation, and the judgment is not linked to the dispute.
No state type for death without male heir ('ohne männlichen Erben verstorbenen'); left out.

Hartwig's status as Klosterministeriale is not recorded; rv:OfficeHolding does not fit a dependent status and the lord of the paternal fief is not named, so the feudal-relationship factoid carries no rv:Lord.

unresolved_identities: Ein Bote Kaiser (Friedrichs): kept as regest-local rf:FunctionalActor; the packet's candidate RI004-002-F000473 is a collective register sub-entry for envoys of the emperor, not an individual.
model_gaps: No role for the principal on whose behalf an envoy negotiates; the emperor is recorded as rv:Participant.
No role for the prospective partners of a negotiated marriage; Konrad and Berengaria are recorded as rv:Participant, not rv:Spouse.
No role for the host at whose court a negotiation takes place; König Alfons is not given a reference in the negotiation, only as parent of Berengaria.
The object of the negotiation is kept only as rf:qualifier "eine Heirat".

unresolved_identities: Grafen Wido von Biandrate: no register candidate in the packet; regest-local actor.
Reich: regest-local group actor as lord of Konrad's fief.
model_gaps: 'er selbst vom Reich zu Lehen trägt' is read as referring to Konrad; the pronoun is a reading.
The heritable character of the enfeoffment is kept only as rf:qualifier "als erbliche Lehen"; no state factoid for Wido's resulting fief was created, because the regest states only the act.
Canale is not modelled as a separate crm:E53_Place; it stays within the label of the possessions.
